notes.title: Alpha Demo Update - More Chaos, More Fixes!
notes.content:
Hey explorers,

I’ve been hard at work shaping the alpha-demo based on your feedback, and I’m really excited to share a fresh update with you! This one adds more challenge, clears up navigation, and fixes some pesky bugs that were holding things back.
🔹 What’s New
Challenging Rooms: Expect more enemies and new laser hazards for extra chaos.

Weapon Drops: Increased drop chances to keep things fairer when the action heats up.
🔹 Improvements
Door Arrows: Now point in the exact direction of exits.

Map Tracker: Unvisited rooms are now marked with a ? for easier exploration.
🔹 Fixes
Character Rotation Bug: No more random spins when switching weapons.

Key Bindings: Your custom keyboard/gamepad setups now save correctly between runs.



Thank you all so much for playing, sharing feedback, and being part of this journey. Every comment and playthrough helps me make O3: Hollow Descent a stronger and stranger experience.

With surreal love,
Simy

notes.title: Update Now Live – New Content & Features
notes.content:
Hey everyone,


Here in Italy, it’s already starting to feel like autumn, even though we’re still technically in summer. I hope you're all getting some well-deserved sun, rest, and good energy, whether you're already on vacation or still waiting for one. Wishing you a great end of summer wherever you are.

Now onto the update: a new build for 03 - Hollow Descent is live on Steam, bringing new content, improved systems, and better customization options.



Here’s what’s included:
[hr][/hr]Totem Reward System
After clearing nearly every combat room, a totem-like structure now spawns and drops random loot:

Weapons

Synthralls

Passive upgrades

This new system adds more consistency and depth to exploration and combat pacing.
[hr][/hr]Faster Dash Refill
Dash cooldown has been shortened to allow quicker evasive movement and support a more aggressive playstyle.
[hr][/hr]Settings Menu Overhaul
The entire settings interface has been restructured into a single, simplified page. New options include:

Movement Type: Switch between World-Based or Screen-Based controls

Gamepad Vibration: Toggle On/Off

Screen Shake: Toggle On/Off

Auto-Aim for Gamepad: Off, Low, Medium, High

Keyboard Movement Rebinding: Fully remappable movement keys
[hr][/hr]Map Tracker Tool + Session Stats
A new map system has been added to help you navigate and track your progress:

Room-by-room tracking of explored areas

Points of interest are revealed upon entering rooms

A Session Stats panel displays key run information:

Time played

Rooms cleared

Enemies killed

Weapons found

Chests opened

Secret rooms discovered
[hr][/hr]
Thank you for playing and supporting 03 - Hollow Descent.
More updates and improvements are coming soon.

Simy

notes.title: Alpha Demo Update: Bug Fixes & Improvements (July 2025)
notes.content:
Quick Update

Hi everyone! Here’s a small but important update to improve your experience:

- Fixed an issue where clicking the close button on the teleport panel would unexpectedly shoot your weapon.

- Weapons now automatically resume firing after reloading:  no need to release and press the fire button again.

- All weapons now correctly track ammo even while holstered, preventing unwanted auto-reloads.

- Increased the spawn rate for certain loot to make runs more rewarding.

- Guaranteed chest key drops: you’ll now always receive at least one chest key during each session run.


That’s it for now. More updates and improvements are coming in the next days.

Thank you so much to everyone playing and sending feedback, it really helps shape the game.
